attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 28 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the page, and it prints no hymn and gives no year. The page calls her Ὁσιομάρτυς, which is why this folder's one type is venerable-martyr; it does not say what monastery she belonged to.
